overview: This Senate resolution designates February 2 through 6, 2026, as National School Counseling Week, matching the designation by the American School Counselor Association. It describes how school counselors help students with academics, emotional well-being, college and career planning, and financial aid, and help schools respond to trauma and violence. It notes that the national average is about 376 students per counselor, compared with the 250-to-1 ratio recommended by professional groups. The resolution encourages Americans to mark the week with activities that raise awareness of counselors' work. The Senate agreed to it on February 4, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution draws attention to the important and often overlooked work school counselors do and to how stretched many of them are.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or provide funding to hire more counselors.
